event: Lumpur Tower cleared MH370 for take-off (RWY 32R KLIA)
notes: MOT Factual Information §1.1.1. ATSB fact sheet often cites departure ~16:41 UTC.

event: Departure from KLIA / commonly cited airborne time (0042 MYT)
notes: Rounded to minute as commonly published (0042 MYT). Climb clearance to FL180 at 16:42:53 UTC per MOT.

event: Crew reported maintaining FL350
Last ACARS communication / B777 position report via SATCOM
notes: MOT: last ACARS at 1707:29 UTC. ATSB ops report: included fuel remaining 43,800 kg. Next expected ~30 min report not received.

event: Crew again reported maintaining FL350
Last radio transmission: "Good night Malaysia Three Seven Zero" (transfer to HCM ACC)
notes: Last recorded radio transmission from MH370. MOT §1.1.1

event: Passed waypoint IGARI (SSR)
notes: MOT radar recording. Exact lat/lon of radar fix not published as coordinates; IGARI waypoint coords in 02_radar_track_points.csv

event: Mode S symbol dropped from Malaysian ATC radar
Last secondary radar (SSR) position symbol (KL ATCC); diversion begins
notes: Last SSR then military radar showed right then left turn to SW. ATSB fact sheet approx. cites final ATC secondary fix ~17:22 UTC.

event: Air turn-back / diversion from filed flight plan begins (military radar)
notes: Military radar: turn right then almost immediately constant left turn to south-westerly. Exact fix coordinates not published.

event: Military radar: heading ~231M, GS ~496 kt, height ~35,700 ft (sample)
notes: MOT sample between 17:30:35–17:35. No published lat/lon for this fix.

event: Radar return slightly south of Penang Island; last KL ATCC primary return
notes: Exact coordinates not published. MOT §1.1.3

event: Military radar time registered over Pulau Perak (Malacca Strait)
notes: Descriptive location only; exact radar lat/lon not published.

event: Last primary radar return: ~10 NM after waypoint MEKAR on airway N571
notes: Final primary radar fix. Exact published coordinates of this fix not in MOT text; MEKAR waypoint coords in radar table as reference only.

event: 1st arc: aircraft-initiated Log-on Request (end of SATCOM link-lost period)
notes: Inmarsat SU log (Malaysia May 2014 release). Link lost sometime between 17:07:48 and 18:03:41. See 03_inmarsat_satcom.csv for BTO/BFO.

event: Unanswered ground-to-air telephony call (zero duration)
notes: BFO available on C-channel; no BTO. Useful for path analysis (southerly trend start).

event: 2nd arc: hourly handshake (Log-on Interrogation + Acknowledge)
notes: See satcom CSV

event: 3rd arc: hourly handshake
notes: See satcom CSV

event: 4th arc: hourly handshake
notes: See satcom CSV

event: 5th arc: hourly handshake
notes: See satcom CSV

event: Second unanswered ground-to-air telephony call
notes: C-channel BFO only

event: 6th arc: hourly handshake (last successful routine handshake)
notes: See satcom CSV

event: 7th arc: aircraft-initiated Log-on Request (partial handshake) — fuel-exhaustion interpretation
notes: ATSB: consistent with SATCOM powering up after power interruption, possibly from fuel exhaustion. Aircraft performance calc consistent with fuel exhaustion near 7th arc.

event: Last transmission received from aircraft terminal (Log-on/Log-off Acknowledge)
notes: Last R-channel burst from aircraft. BFO=-2 Hz used in end-of-flight descent analysis (ATSB).

event: Handshake Request — no response from aircraft (and retries 01:16:06, 01:16:15)
notes: Confirms aircraft no longer responding after 00:19.
